senses.def: The military intelligence service of the German Weimar Republic and Third Reich, from 1920 to 1944 or 1945.
A piece of exercise equipment designed to be gripped in one or both hands and torqued in the course of sagittally abducting the pronated shoulders with the core resisting flexion and extension.
A tax, or impost, levied by a chief on a landowner.
a power unit equal to the power dissipated when 1 abampere flows across a potential difference of 1 abvolt (one ten-thousandth of a milliwatt)
A unit of electrical power equal to one ten-millionth of a watt (10⁻⁷ watts), used in the centimeter-gram-second system of units.
A traditional African religion or cult based around male ancestral spirits thought to be audible but not visible.
